description: Generate a BATCH of premium creatives of one asset type (SAC), or bulk-order N assets in one request (bulk* actions: pricing, order, status, assets, cancel — credits charged upfront, failed items auto-refund) — image: 6 image ads (3 with text + 3 clean) · video: 4 video ads · ugc_action: 3 UGC presenter videos (the way to order UGC videos; named UGC in the app) · ugc_video: only the script-only Talking Actors order (a product ugc_video order is refused 503 REGULAR_UGC_UNAVAILABLE — send ugc_action) · google_ads: 12 ad variations. create → (customize) → confirm. Interactive UGC/in-action uses confirm sub-payloads. pricing / eligibility quote the credit cost first. Talking Actors "Create Variations": variationsQuote (free) says whether a finished Talking Actors video can get 3 new videos of the same actor acting its script in 3 places that fit it, and the exact credits; createVariations spends credits (that figure) and returns the new campaign_id to poll. Any length of source video works: one whose script runs past 30 s gets 30 s variations with the script condensed (the quote says shortened: true). createVariations optionally takes the product — a product photo (product_image_url, from the product-image upload) OR a product page link (product_url, read for the product's name, details and photos), not both — and the brand (brand_id of one of your brands, or no_brand: true; neither keeps the source video's brand, which the quote returns as brand). Actions: pricing, eligibility, create, confirm, cancel, status, assets, regenerateAsset, downloadAll, variationsQuote, createVariations, bulkPricing, bulkOrder, bulkStatus, bulkAssets, bulkCancel. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
